name: nvidia_driver

apt_policy_blacklist.rationale: This policy file keeps the NVIDIA coupled package set version-coherent under guard update control.

storage.rationale: The safeguard owns the apt policy file that prevents unattended upgrades from separating the running kernel from its NVIDIA module set.

description: Validate and repair the NVIDIA kernel driver for the running Ubuntu kernel, and keep the compute device nodes durable across boots, when NVIDIA display hardware is present

invariants.statement: The capability module set is loadable for the running kernel.
The running kernel and capability module set move together during host updates.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

linux.evidence: The Linux provider and host safeguard were exercised on this host after the 2026-08-25 NVIDIA kernel-module repair; the running driver is serving CUDA workloads. A durable structured run record is not available, so this claim remains build-verified until that evidence is captured.

macos.evidence: NVIDIA display hardware is not supported by current Mac hardware, so this Linux kernel-driver safeguard cannot apply.

windows.evidence: Windows driver-store and kernel-module management for NVIDIA hardware is a defined capability gap; no provider is wired yet.
